shared.change: P1. Disabled buttons stop looking broken. Today the shared rule is only `opacity: 0.5` (components.css line 403 to 407, plus a duplicate `opacity: 0.55` in OwnerDashboard.css 1158 to 1163 and `.zs-btn:disabled` in settings.css 90). On the Zella theme's near-black primary, that turns into a flat mid grey pill. Replace it with one rule in components.css: `.owner-primary-button:disabled, .owner-button-primary:disabled, .ba-btn.primary:disabled, .zs-btn.primary:disabled, .cp-button:disabled, .bp-primary:disabled { background: var(--zella-subtle); color: var(--zella-text-faint); border: 1px solid var(--zella-border); box-shadow: none; opacity: 1; cursor: not-allowed }`. Secondary buttons keep `opacity: .5`. Delete the duplicate disabled rules in OwnerDashboard.css, settings.css and billing.css (line 61). Rule of use: a disabled primary always has a short reason next to it, as onboarding already does.

P1. One button system, matched to the shipped default theme. zella-theme.css (the default look) makes every button a 999px pill, while DESIGN_SYSTEM.md still describes the Classic look (mocha, 8px). Keep the pill shape, since it is the signature of the shipped theme, and fix the doc instead of the CSS. In components.css, add a small size `.owner-secondary-button.sm, .zs-btn.sm, .ba-btn.sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--zella-space-3); font-size: var(--zella-text-sm) }` and a quiet text action `.owner-link-button` (no border, color var(--zella-text), font-weight 600, underline only on hover and focus). Add the sm and link variants to the zella-theme.css pill selector list. Table rule, written into DESIGN_SYSTEM.md under Tables: the action cell holds at most one `.owner-secondary-button.sm`, plus an optional icon-only overflow button (`more_horiz`, with an aria-label). It has no underlined bare links, never stacks actions vertically, and uses `td.col-actions { width: 1%; white-space: nowrap; text-align: right }`.

P1. Table rhythm and no broken words. Add these rules to components.css for `.owner-table`. `td { vertical-align: middle; padding: 10px var(--zella-space-4) }`. `.owner-table-secondary { display: block; max-width: 28ch; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: var(--zella-text-secondary); font-size: var(--zella-text-xs) }`. A shared `.owner-cell-truncate { max-width: 220px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap }` for emails and long names, with the full value in a `title`. `.owner-table .op-pill, .owner-table .owner-badge { white-space: nowrap }`. `td.num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums }`. Never use `overflow-wrap: anywhere` or `break-all` on table text (OwnerPages.css 909, and `.bl-email` on the businesses branch).

P1. Phone tables become cards. Add an opt-in `.owner-table--cards` to components.css, under `@media (max-width: 600px)`: `thead { display: none }`, `tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 4px var(--zella-space-3); padding: var(--zella-space-3) var(--zella-space-4) }`, `td { padding: 0; border: 0 }`, `td[data-label]::before { content: attr(data-label); display: block; color: var(--zella-text-secondary); font-size: var(--zella-text-xs) }`, and `td.col-actions { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 }`. Extend `DataTable` in adminOps.jsx to accept `cards` and a column `label`, and to emit `data-label`. Tables that stay as tables on a phone get a right-edge fade on `.owner-table-wrap` (`mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 90%, transparent)` while it can scroll).

P1. One empty value. Add `EmptyValue({ label = 'None' })` to adminOps.jsx, rendering `<span className="empty-value">`, with `.empty-value { color: var(--zella-text-faint); font-weight: 400 }` in components.css. Use one word per kind of value: 'None' for lists and counts, 'Not set' for configuration, 'Never' for times. A cell is never blank. `Facts`, `when()` and `num()` in adminOps.jsx render EmptyValue instead of the bare strings ('Not available' becomes 'Not set'). Document this in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md Writing.

P1. One page header. Extend `PageHeader` in adminOps.jsx to `{ eyebrow, title, description, actions, updatedAt, onRefresh }`. The eyebrow equals the sidebar group (Businesses, Configuration, AI and communications, Operations). The H1 equals the sidebar label. 'Updated 2:44 PM' plus a Refresh secondary sm button always sits in the header actions, left of the single primary button. The card-level Refresh disappears. Rename the sidebar item 'AI agents' to 'AI receptionists' so the breadcrumb, nav and H1 match (navigation config).

P1. One badge, and filters that do not look like primary buttons. In components.css, give `.op-pill, .owner-badge` the same shape: `height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: var(--zella-text-xs); font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--zella-radius-full); border: 0; white-space: nowrap`, with tones from `--zella-{success,info,warning,danger}-bg` and foreground. Neutral uses `--zella-subtle` with `--zella-text-secondary`. Tone map: Live, Active, Ready are success. Trial, In progress, Scheduled are info. Draft, Not yet, Pending are warning. Use the same map everywhere. In `Tabs` (`.op-tabs`) and the filter chip groups (`.ao-chip`), the selected state is `background: var(--zella-primary-soft); color: var(--zella-text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--zella-primary-border)`, never a midnight fill. The tab row scrolls in one line (`flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto`) with a right-edge fade.

P1. Headings stay readable at small sizes. zella-theme.css applies Inter Tight with `-0.02em` to every h1 and h2, which closes the word spaces at 16 to 18px ('All businesses' reads as one word). Limit the display font and tracking to page headings (`h1, .owner-page-heading h1, .zs-head h1`). Card and section h2 and h3 use `var(--zella-font)`, weight 600, `letter-spacing: 0`. In OwnerDashboard.css (lines 80, 94, 163, 263 to 264, 366 to 367, 429) remove the fixed `font-weight: 750` and `letter-spacing: -0.8px`, and let components.css set the heading weight (600).

P1. Settings rows and one save bar (SettingsKit). Replace the per-setting card (heading, key, Value label, input, help, divider, Cancel and Save) with a compact `.zs-row`. Label and help sit on the left at 40%, the input on the right (max-width 240px for numbers), and the setting key goes in a 'Technical details' disclosure, not under every label. Use one sticky save bar per section ('2 unsaved changes', Discard, Save), like the Industry configuration footer, and no Save or Cancel row while nothing has changed. Settings whose database column is missing collapse into one info banner at the top ('Five settings are waiting for a database update', with a list), and their rows show a neutral 'Not available yet' badge instead of five amber banners. The field label never repeats the card title (use aria-label).

P2. One KPI card. `Metric` in adminOps.jsx and `.owner-stat-card` show a label (13px, secondary), a value (32px, 600, tabular-nums), a note (12px, secondary, one line with ellipsis) and a fixed min-height, with no coloured icon tiles. A card that filters the list is a real button or link (hover border, focus ring, `chevron_right`), so a caption such as 'Show them' is never plain bold text. Use it on Businesses, Overview, AI receptionists and Operations.

P2. One table footer and one selected row. `Pager` in adminOps.jsx always renders a `.owner-table-foot` inside the card padding (`display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: var(--zella-space-3) var(--zella-space-4)`). The left side says 'Showing 1 to 25 of 96' (or '3 shown'). The right side has Previous and Next as `.owner-secondary-button.sm`, which become chevron icon buttons under 600px. Selected row everywhere: `background: var(--zella-primary-soft); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--zella-primary)` (no black bar, no peach fill on unselected rows). Clickable rows (`.ao-clickable`) get `cursor: pointer` and a hover `var(--zella-alt)`.

P2. Drawers. `Drawer` in adminOps.jsx gets the header pattern: a 12px secondary eyebrow ('Plan'), the title (the business name) at 18px 600, and an optional status badge on the right. It gets an optional `footer` prop rendered as a sticky `.ao-drawer-foot` (`position: sticky; bottom: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--zella-border); background: var(--zella-card); padding: 12px 20px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px`). `.ao-facts` becomes `grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 40%) 1fr; column-gap: 16px`, with keys at 13px secondary and values at 14px 500. Add `.drawer-section h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 16px }`.

P2. Shared filters row. `Filters` (`.op-filters`) becomes one grid row: `grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, 2fr) repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; align-items: end`, with every control (search, selects, dates, Clear) at 36px. Checkbox filters such as 'Has a problem' become a toggle chip (`aria-pressed`) in the same row. Clear filters is a text button at the end. Under 600px the filters fold behind a 'Filters (2)' secondary button.

P2. Info banner readability. In `.owner-info-banner` and `.banner-info`, the body text uses `var(--zella-text-2)` at weight 400. Only the lead phrase uses `var(--zella-info)` at 600, with an `info` icon at 20px. Banners stay at two lines at most, with more detail behind a disclosure. Add a matching `.banner-warning` for inline table notices ('1 job is not in the state recorded for it').

P2. One format module for numbers, times and phones (writing rule: phones use spaces). Add web/src/lib/format.js, or extend ownerFormat.js, with: formatCount (Intl.NumberFormat, '1,203'), formatRelative ('5 days ago', 'Yesterday', never '5 d ago', with the full timestamp in `title`), formatPhone ('(555) 123 0001', not E.164), formatTimeZone ('Eastern Time (New York)', not 'America/New_York') and formatDateTime ('Nov 16, 2026 at 2:49 PM'). Column heads read 'AI calls, last 30 days'. Route `when`, `num` and `duration` in adminOps.jsx through it.

P3. The sidebar column fills the page. `.owner-sidebar` is `position: sticky; height: 100vh` inside a flex row, so on long pages the column background ends after one screen, and a scrolled capture shows the nav floating mid page (Businesses, Alert rules, Support). Put the background and right border on a stretching column wrapper (`align-self: stretch; background: var(--zella-sidebar)`), and make only the inner nav sticky (`top: 0; height: 100vh; overflow: auto`). Make the settings sub nav `.zs-nav` `align-self: start; position: sticky; top: var(--zella-space-6)`. Check it in a real scrolled browser as well as in full page shots.

P3. Update DESIGN_SYSTEM.md to match what ships. Describe the Zella theme as the default (paper, midnight action colour, coral only for selected and live, pill buttons, Inter Tight for page headings only) alongside Classic and Glass. List the shared components every new admin page must use: PageHeader, Metric (KPI), DataTable with Pager footer and card mode, Drawer with footer, Badge tones, EmptyValue, banners, the Settings row and save bar, and the format helpers.
